security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: The SQL container manifest provides the SA_PASSWORD environment variable as a literal value at line 24, so the SQL administrative credential is stored in deployment configuration rather than retrieved from a secret store.
